name: SpiceJet Ltd
tagline: AVOID -- Q3 FY26 shareholder funds about -Rs 1,942 Cr, auditors flagging a going-concern material uncertainty, and mounting quarterly losses
business_overview: SpiceJet is a low-cost Indian airline that has been through years of financial distress -- lessor disputes, grounded aircraft, litigation and repeated fundraising. A large FY25 capital raise briefly turned net worth positive, but subsequent losses have eroded it again.
fundamentals_table: Q3 FY26 shareholder funds ~ -Rs 1,942 Cr (negative again after briefly turning positive in Q1 FY26)
TTM loss ~ -Rs 813 Cr; Q2 FY26 net loss ~Rs 633 Cr; Q3 FY26 consolidated net loss ~Rs 261 Cr (vs a small profit a year earlier)
Material uncertainty related to going concern; substantial accumulated losses; current liabilities exceed current assets
fundamentals_narrative: Net worth is negative again, the airline is loss-making at the operating and net level, and the statutory auditors continue to flag a material uncertainty over its ability to continue as a going concern. This is a balance-sheet in distress, not a turnaround with a margin of safety.
technical_read: Not pulled -- stock down ~70% in a year, near its 52-week low.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-read -- red-flag AVOID stops the process at Step 3. Thread is small (~27 posts).
bse_notes: Auditors have raised a going-concern material uncertainty; accumulated losses have eroded net worth; long-running lessor-dues and litigation history.
bull_case: Market share reportedly recovered from ~1.9% to ~4.3% between Sep and Dec 2025 on fleet reactivation
Q3 FY26 revenue up ~14-77% YoY (depending on basis) as grounded aircraft returned to service
bear_case: Negative net worth (~ -Rs 1,942 Cr in Q3 FY26) and a going-concern qualification
Persistent large quarterly losses; low interest-coverage; history of lessor disputes and litigation
Airline economics are structurally fragile; any fuel or demand shock could be terminal
verdict_headline: AVOID -- negative net worth and a going-concern material uncertainty
verdict_reasoning: Red-flag tier AVOID: Q3 FY26 shareholder funds ~ -Rs 1,942 Cr and a statutory going-concern material uncertainty -- this stops the process regardless of any operational recovery narrative
Losses are still mounting (Q2 FY26 ~ -Rs 633 Cr, Q3 FY26 ~ -Rs 261 Cr) and a brief Q1 FY26 positive net worth has already reversed
First-time pass; filtered at Step 3, no deep thread read; thesis_fit neither, conviction Low
Not investable until net worth is durably positive and the going-concern qualification is removed
red_flag_reason: Q3 FY26 shareholder funds approximately -Rs 1,942 Cr (negative net worth); statutory auditors flag a material uncertainty related to going concern; substantial accumulated losses with current liabilities exceeding current assets.
